HOK_KOR_chinese_government_mtg_tt: The §YTogether for Victory§! DLC is enabled
HOK_KOR_chinese_government_chi_democracy: §YChina§! exists and has §Yat least 50%§! democratic support
HOK_KOR_chinese_government_no_existing_t: The Free Republic of Shandong does not yet exist
HOK_KOR_chinese_government_seed_tt: Shandong or Qingdao contains a §Ysafe foothold fully controlled by a Chinese country§! (excluding territory owned or controlled by Korea or the Japanese side; the original owner must hold at least 1 other state)
HOK_KOR_chinese_government_effect_tt:
Establish the §YFree Republic of Shandong§! in Shandong as §Ya Korean dominion§! and grant it cores on mainland China.
Secure eligible §Yfootholds in Shandong and Qingdao§! and §Yall eligible mainland territory owned by the Shandong warlord§! as founding territory, regardless of democratic support.
Other Chinese countries contribute additional states connected by land to the founding territory according to their democratic support when the focus completes, up to §Y90%§!. Existing Shandong and Qingdao footholds count against their original owner's territorial allocation.
For each country that actually contributes territory, the same support-based defection share applies to its army, navy, air force, stockpiled equipment and fuel. Existing commanders are excluded from the defections. Equipment, convoys and fuel left behind by a Shandong warlord that disappears through full integration are discarded.
Existing airfields needed for air-force defections are secured first. If no usable airfield is available in the territory to be integrated, a level 1 airfield is established at the new government's foothold.
§YTerritory owned or controlled by Korea, Japan or Japanese subjects, and Manchuria§! will not be transferred.
Korea gains war goals against all existing designated targets: China, Communist China and 14 warlords. Declaring or joining wars follows the normal diplomatic rules.
HOK_KOR_expand_secret_intelligence_servi: Diplomatic reports and newspaper articles alone cannot tell us everything about events in Asia. We need contacts who understand local conditions and specialist departments for codebreaking, signals interception and covert operations. Our government will bring these scattered intelligence activities together in a secret intelligence service, identifying threats beyond our borders before they reach us and maintaining reliable networks overseas.
HOK_KOR_secret_intelligence_service_idea: Reports from overseas missions and local contacts pass through the desks of translators and analysts before informing the government's decisions. The Secret Intelligence Service brings together communications and cryptographic specialists, operatives who know local conditions, and the networks that carry their supplies. Dangerous operations can now be prepared more carefully, while reliable contact is maintained with those abroad who share our aims.
HOK_KOR_democratic_support_category_desc: Printing presses that produce a free newspaper and civic groups that meet in secret need funds as well as conviction. We will help democrats in China and Japan continue their work.
HOK_KOR_support_democracy_in_china_desc: We will fund leaflets distributed beyond the reach of warlord censorship and support local democratic organisations. Even in a China divided among rival factions, the voices of those who want a free government must not be silenced.\n\nAll existing designated recipients are supported together. If any recipient still has earlier support, another payment must wait until that support expires. Countries that appear after support begins are included from the next payment onwards. Once granted, support lasts for its remaining duration despite changes of government or diplomatic relations; it cannot be cancelled or refunded.
HOK_KOR_support_democracy_in_japan_desc: We will send funds to Japanese journalists and civic groups who resist censorship. Those seeking to restore a free parliament and the rights of citizens must not be left isolated.\n\nIf Japan still has earlier support, another payment must wait until that support expires. Once granted, support lasts for its remaining duration despite changes of government or diplomatic relations; it cannot be cancelled or refunded.
HOK_KOR_democratic_support_china_recipie: At least one designated Chinese recipient exists
HOK_KOR_democratic_support_china_no_exis: No existing Chinese recipient has ongoing democratic support
HOK_KOR_democratic_support_japan_no_exis: Japan has no ongoing democratic support

KOR_minshu_ikki_tt: Japanese democrats begin a civil war. Democratic support immediately before the uprising determines the territorial share and the proportions of the army, navy, air force and stockpiles allocated to it (minimum 10%, maximum 90%). Territory is divided by whole states. We welcome the democratic government into our faction and automatically join the war on its side.

KOR_support_for_democracy_in_china_desc: China's democrats need the strength to defend freedom amid warlords and military dictators. We will establish clandestine channels with them and provide steady political backing and the supplies needed for resistance.
KOR_overthrow_the_chinese_dictators_desc: The contacts who have slipped past warlord checkpoints are ready to establish a government in Shandong. This will be the first foothold where those who seek a free China can gather. We must protect the new government and turn the support built up by democratic movements across the country into a force capable of uniting China.
KOR_support_for_democracy_in_japan_desc: Since the end of Taisho Democracy, Japanese democrats have suffered repression under militarism and feudalism. We will contact their clandestine organisations and provide supplies and political backing so that they can continue preparing to regain their freedom.
KOR_minshu_ikki_desc: Japanese democrats are finally ready to rise. The support they have built and the cooperation they have secured within the armed forces will determine the scale of the uprising. We will welcome them as allies and fight alongside them to end militarist rule in Japan.
